description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ChannelListing/GetCategorySpecifics. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns category field definitions and populated values for manual product preparation. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use when the manual product form needs fields for its selected category and supplier product data. Input: GetCategorySpecificsRequest: SourceId, Price, CategoryId, Title, Paragraphs, Features, TableValues. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Admin: false. Output: response_data remains the category field collection. Admin or impersonated sessions additionally receive debug alongside response_data, with actual product inputs and returned definitions, restrictions and values. Missing initial values, internal filling decisions and browser-side changes are explicitly marked as unavailable, never inferred. A failed category-field request includes admin debug with its trace ID in the error response. Search terms: channellisting getcategoryspecifics. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
